plainTranslation: Obsessive, magnetic love. The connection can feel consuming. The draw is enormous; so is the possessiveness. Watch fixation and jealousy. Hard aspects tip toward control; smooth ones transform without the cage. Magnetic and bad-for-you can be the same bond - name which one this is.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
